homologous_pair.name: Homologous Chromosome Pair (Bivalent)
homologous_pair.description: Pair of matching maternal and paternal chromosomes carrying identical gene loci that pair up closely during synapsis in Prophase I.

sister_chromatids.name: Sister Chromatids
sister_chromatids.description: Two identical copies of a replicated chromosome joined together at the centromere, produced during interphase DNA replication.

non_sister_chromatids.name: Non-Sister Chromatids
non_sister_chromatids.description: Chromatids belonging to different homologous chromosomes within a bivalent that can physically cross over and exchange genetic material.

chiasma.name: Chiasma (Point of Genetic Exchange)
chiasma.description: X-shaped physical junction where non-sister chromatids break and rejoin, swapping equivalent reciprocal segments of maternal and paternal DNA.

centromere.name: Centromere
centromere.description: Specialized condensed heterochromatin region holding duplicated sister chromatids together until Anaphase II of meiosis.

recombinant_chromatids.name: Recombinant Chromatid (Mosaic)
recombinant_chromatids.description: Chromatid containing a novel mosaic combination of maternal and paternal alleles resulting from crossing over, driving genetic variation.

non_recombinant_chromatids.name: Non-Recombinant Chromatid (Parental)
non_recombinant_chromatids.description: Chromatid that did not participate in crossing over, retaining the original unmodified parental linkage of alleles.
